name: Telepathy

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a pair of linked silver rings

targets.description: a willing creature you are familiar with

summary: A two-way telepathic link with a willing creature you know, anywhere on your plane, for 24 hours.
text: You can share words, images, sounds and other sensations instantly, and the creature understands you without a shared language. It ends if either of you leaves the plane.
